quotes.text: I will be a proud voice for policies that put all Americans on a path to prosperity, including preparing Americans for jobs in the 21st Century amidst the rise of AI, advocating for universal pre-K, reinstating reproductive rights, fighting inflation and ensuring Americans’ hard earned dollars go further.
Politicians and Big Tech billionaires want to put data centers in our backyard without asking us...I will make sure YOUR voice has a seat at the table, not just the politicians and billionaires.

Now that’s this educator’s kind of data center! Are algorithms or adults going to raise our kids? AI will never replace teachers, and we will protect students and adults while AI becomes a part of American life. We need educators around the table in DC making decisions in the best interest of our kids, and I want to be one of them.

My name is Pia Dandiya. I’m a mom, educator and Floridian running for Congress. It’s time we had more educators around the table making decisions for our kids. Help us elect a teacher to Congress!

#FL22
the number one thing that keeps me up at night is that we have no AI regulation.

This girl is running for Congress to fight for a future worthy not only of my kiddo, but yours too. It’s time we move beyond this partisan, performative politics to unite in service of our kids and what version of this country we are handing to them. As a teacher, principal and mom, I’m fired up to move forward common sense policies that will give us all stability and opportunity. To move beyond culture wars and towards actual progress for the issues of our time - healthcare, affordability, corruption, AI, our budget and so much more.

You have a role to play in how we move forward too, but voting for leaders who share your vision for our future. Let’s unite to make Florida kind again - and to rise above the noise in honor of our kids.

#Mom #FL22
